entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return an item. Order number is 774-B-921.
Okay, let me just pull up that order for you. 774-B-921... I see it here. It's for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet. Before we proceed, can I ask what specifically is the issue?
It's simple. The color is wrong, it doesn't match my kit. I just need to know if I can return it or not.
I understand. I just need to confirm a few things for the return process. The box is unopened, correct?
Yes, the box is unopened. It's brand new. The safety seals are all intact.
Perfect. I see the delivery was 48 days ago. Let me just check the policy for this helmet.
Look, is it a yes or a no? I don't have all day.
It's a yes. Apologies for the delay. The helmet falls under our standard 90-day return policy, so you are well within the window. I can process this for you right now.
Great. Finally. So you're sending a return label?

Yes, I'm emailing that to you as we speak. Just print it out, attach it to the shipping box, and drop it off at any carrier location. Once we receive it, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method.
Okay. I've got the email. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
